title: Coordinate sum homomorphism
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The coordinate-sum map sends $x\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$ to $\sum_{i\in S}x_i$ in $\mathbb F_2$; it is an additive homomorphism.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
